title: Transport bodies call indefinite strike from today across Assam

ai.summary: Transport bodies in Assam called an indefinite strike from November 26, citing policy inconsistencies in Speed Limiting Devices (SLDs) and Vehicle Location Tracking Devices (VLTDs) installation and management.

facts.claim: indefinite statewide strike of commercial transport services from November 26
facts.quote: The All Assam Motor Transport Association and other private transport organisations across the state have called an indefinite statewide strike of commercial transport services from November 26

facts.claim: alleging policy inconsistencies and irregularities in the installation of Speed Limiting Devices (SLDs) and Vehicle Location Tracking Devices (VLTDs)
facts.quote: alleging policy inconsistencies and irregularities in the installation of Speed Limiting Devices (SLDs) and Vehicle Location Tracking Devices (VLTDs)

facts.claim: gave the government until November 25 to address its demands
facts.quote: the association said it had given the government until November 25 to address its demands

facts.claim: objected to disproportionate burden on vehicle owners and drivers
facts.quote: it described as the disproportionate burden placed on vehicle owners and drivers
a monopoly in SLD installation since 2017 had left vehicle owners struggling to access the devices

facts.claim: demanded multiple authorised agencies for SLD installation
facts.quote: demanded that multiple authorised agencies be allowed to sell and install them

facts.claim: opposed testing vehicle speed by lifting vehicles with jacks
facts.quote: It also opposed testing vehicle speed by lifting vehicles with jacks

facts.claim: questioned SOP assigning DTO offices to upload SLD certificates
facts.quote: citing staff shortages and inadequate equipment

facts.claim: demanded one modern Automated Testing Station in every district
facts.quote: demanded at least one modern Automated Testing Station in every district

facts.claim: demanded one-month window for settling traffic challans
facts.quote: demanded a one-month window for settling traffic challans

facts.claim: demanded Transport Appellate Tribunals in every district
facts.quote: demanded Transport Appellate Tribunals in every district

facts.claim: demanded protection against harassment during certificate renewal
facts.quote: demanded protection against harassment during the renewal of fitness certificates, permits and PUC certificates

facts.claim: Assam's system depended on a single agency for VLTD installation
facts.quote: On VLTD installation, the association alleged that Assam's system depended on a single agency despite the Union Ministry of Road Transport and Highways having approved 168 agencies

facts.claim: demanded option of purchasing and installing VLTDs through multiple agencies
facts.quote: It demanded the option of purchasing and installing devices through multiple authorised agencies
